args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 began failing health checks in all production regions immediately after deploy. Rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) from v2.3.1 to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback completed and verified; service health re-confirmed post-rollback. Root cause of v2.3.1 failure pending investigation.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions

trace.final:
All done. Summary of actions:

1. **Investigated the failure**: Reviewed deployment history — the latest deploy, **v2.3.1**, was unhealthy in production; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back**: v2.3.0 was rolled out to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and verified.
3. **Confirmed recovery**: checkout-api is now reporting healthy on v2.3.0 with a low error rate (~0.2%).
4. **Opened incident**: Created **INC-0001** (SEV2) describing the failed v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0. The on-call engineer has been paged for follow-up/root-cause investigation of the v2.3.1 failure.
